name: Kitchen Drawer Organization
heroHeadline: Precision Drawer Systems That Eliminate Utensil Chaos
heroDescription: Transform jammed flatware drawers and tangled deep cookware into calm, purposeful zones with custom-fit bamboo dividers, tiered spice inserts, and measurement-tested storage solutions.
heroImageAlt: Elegantly organized kitchen drawer with natural bamboo cutlery partitions
keyProblemsSolved: Jammed drawer tracks caused by oversized cooking spoons catching the upper cabinet lip
Cutlery sliding backward every time a drawer is pulled open vigorously
Hidden duplicate spice bottles that expire before they are found
Deep lower drawers degenerating into a chaotic pile of mismatched pot lids
measurementAdvice: Always measure three interior cabinet dimensions with a rigid steel tape measure: the interior width (side-to-side), interior depth (front-to-back), and interior vertical clearance from drawer floor to cabinet box frame.

name: Under-Sink Storage
heroHeadline: Maximize Every Inch of Difficult Plumbing Space
heroDescription: Conquer the most challenging cabinet in the American home. Work around garbage disposals, P-traps, and water lines with two-tier sliding caddies, U-shaped organizers, and non-drill door storage.
heroImageAlt: Bright organized under-sink kitchen cabinet with sliding metal baskets and eco-friendly cleaning supplies
keyProblemsSolved: Awkward garbage disposals and P-trap drain lines blocking conventional shelving
Dark, unreachable back-cabinet voids where half-empty cleaning bottles accumulate
Drip damage and chemical spills warping untreated wood cabinet bases
Renter limitations preventing screw-in hardware installations
measurementAdvice: Measure the clearance on both the left and right sides of your center drain pipe separately. Check height clearance beneath the garbage disposal canister and leave at least 1 inch of buffer for water shutoff valve handles.

name: Pantry Organization
heroHeadline: Curated Pantry Systems Built for Real Daily Life
heroDescription: Design a pantry that looks like a calm boutique grocer and works effortlessly for busy households. Modular airtight containers, 360-degree turntables, and stepped risers keep every ingredient visible.
heroImageAlt: Pantry shelving with uniform airtight food jars, bamboo turntables, and woven storage baskets
keyProblemsSolved: Bagged grains and open flour sacks attracting moisture, pantry moths, and spills
Corner dead zones where duplicate oils and sauces get pushed out of sight and expire
Tall, deep shelves where vertical cubic space goes entirely wasted
Lack of category zoning leading to messy daily rummaging before dinner
measurementAdvice: Measure shelf depth carefully. Standard kitchen wall cabinets are 11"-12" deep, while pantry closets range from 14" to 24" deep. Select modular canisters whose footprints multiply cleanly across your usable shelf width.
